LISTING_TAGLINE: A vaulted-ceiling Okanagan retreat with a private pool
META_DESCRIPTION: Broadview House — a vaulted-ceiling Okanagan vacation retreat in West Kelowna, BC. Sleeps 10 across 4 bedrooms plus den, with a private inground pool and wrap-around deck.
GALLERY_ALT: Modern updated cedar exterior at golden hour
Private fenced backyard oasis with mature landscaping
Vaulted ceilings and natural wood detail in the great room
Wood-burning brick fireplace with modern mantle
Kitchen workspace with full appliance suite
Dining area off the kitchen with deck access
Main-floor primary bedroom with pool view
Second main-floor bedroom with pool view
HOST_BLURB: Hosting Broadview House since 2022. Born and raised in the Okanagan; happiest when guests find their own quiet corner of the deck.

REVIEWS.body: We were a group of nine and Broadview House had room to spread out. The pool kept the kids happy from sunrise. Mara was a thoughtful host.
Vaulted ceilings, the brick fireplace at night, and the deck for morning coffee. Quiet street, easy drive to wineries. Already planning a return.
A premium, calm space. Loved the warm wood finishes. The location is genuinely peaceful — felt private in the best way.
